cheats.name: Have All Groups Completed
cheats.note: This gives you all Cups for all Groups.

cheats.name: Have Everything Unlocked
cheats.note: This will unlock Cars, Races, Missions and the in-built Cheat Menu. This will also replace all the Zombies with  Dinosaurs. To access Cheat menu options: Pause Game: Use Control Stick, to scroll the Cheat Menu. Press A, to activate Cheats

cheats.name: Max Credits
cheats.note: This is also Infinite until disabled

cheats.name: Max Kills
cheats.note: This will automatically Clear the stage if enabled and go back to the stage menu
